abstractTranslation: Neural Machine Translation System from Russian to English. Growing importance of machine translation (multilingual content). Revolution of NMT vs previous approaches (SMT). Dominant architecture: Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017). Project Objectives: 1 Develop an NMT system for English -> Russian. 2 Use open-source tools (Hugging Face) and public data (opus_books). 3 Fine-tune a pre-trained model (Helsinki-NLP). 4 Evaluate (BLEU, chrF) and compare to the state-of-the-art. 1. This model is based on the Transformer architecture and implemented using the MarianMT framework. Transition from SMT to NMT (RNNs (Bahdanau et al., 2015) -> Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017)). Importance of parallel data (WMT (Ng et al., 2019), OPUS (Tiedemann, 2012)). Bilingual pre-trained models: MarianMT (Helsinki-NLP) 2 (Junczys-Dowmunt et al., 2018) on OPUS. Solid foundation for fine-tuning. Massive multilingual models: NLLB (Costa-Jussa et al., 2022) often dominates, with EN-RU BLEU scores > 40 on WMT benchmarks (Ng et al., 2019; Costa-Jussa et al., 2022). 2. Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-ru is a pre-trained model specifically for English to Russian translation.
titleTranslation: Neural Machine Translation of Russian-English
zotero.title: Traduction automatique neuronale du Russe-Anglais
